name: hmi_export_json
description: Export a Unified HMI target as versioned JSON files. Omit output_directory to stage a remote-readable export and return a transfer_id.

compact.description: Omit item properties equal to their TIA-created type defaults (default: true).

output_directory.description: Optional local server directory. Omit for a staged export readable with hmi_read_export_file.

script_files.description: Write event scripts into .js sidecar files instead of inline JSON strings (default: false).

target_name.description: Target HMI software/device selector (optional when only one target exists).
